answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism: conviction-weighted reputation. Like a mesa, an agent's standing must be built layer by layer -- new accounts start at near-zero weight no matter how many an attacker spawns. Honest work grows the agent's garden of reputation, which decays without steady participation, so farmers cannot park identities and harvest later. And make rewards a long voyage: payouts vest over many epochs, so 10,000 sybils earn nothing until each has paid months of honest effort -- pushing attacker cost above any possible gain.
